senses.gloss: how easily others can check it
senses.caution: People hear it as trustworthy, but a number can be easy to check and still wrong. Promise it only if you can say who checks it and against what.
senses.definition: Whether a claim can be checked by someone other than whoever made it.

gloss_distractors: how easily others can check it
senses.caution: It only covers tasks with a checkable answer, so do not promise it for memos or judgement calls. Non-technical people may think it means a bonus scheme.
senses.definition: Training signal a machine can check on its own, like a test passing or a proof compiling.
